surfaces.says: GitHub Actions runs every workflow file under `.github/workflows/` (`.yml` or `.yaml`) of the pushed commit whose `on:` names the event, taken from the GitHub Actions documentation (workflow syntax; events that trigger workflows; variables). Documented, and NOT OBSERVED here (nothing was pushed): a `run` step with `shell: sh` runs as `sh -e {0}` from the checked-out workspace, and fails the job on a non-zero exit; `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH` names the webhook payload as JSON; for `pull_request` its `pull_request.base.sha` is the base the change is proposed against and HEAD is the test merge commit; for `push` its `before` is the commit the ref held, all zeros for a new ref; `actions/checkout` with `fetch-depth: 0` fetches all history, so both commits are present. MEASURED locally only: the served step commands, run by `sh -e` against a fixture event and a fixture diff, refuse a violating change and admit a clean one. UNVERIFIED: a force-push whose `before` is no longer reachable (the diff cannot be read, so the run refuses -- fail closed, not judged), a pull request from a fork, and the runner image's Python. The runner's clone is EPHEMERAL: no door was ever walked in it, so a setting outside the tree that a working clone must hold (a hook path) is named NOT MEASURED there, never failed and never passed. Every other file in `.github/workflows/` is the owner's; the kit writes exactly the path its record names and refuses to write over bytes it did not write. Review owners: GitHub reads CODEOWNERS from .github/, the repository root or docs/ (the first found), each line a gitignore-style pattern and its owners (@user, @org/team or an email), the LAST matching line winning; a pull request then requests their review, and their approval is REQUIRED only where branch protection says `require_code_owner_reviews` -- taken from GitHub's CODEOWNERS and branch-protection documentation; NOT OBSERVED here. The kit serves one span of .github/CODEOWNERS; the file is the owner's.

controls.says: The default branch requires this workflow's `gates` check, an up-to-date branch, one approving review and the code owners' review, admins included -- set on GitHub by `PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/{branch}/protection` (REST API 2022-11-28); the kit neither sets nor reads it.
controls.command: echo '{"required_status_checks":{"strict":true,"contexts":["gates"]},"enforce_admins":true,"required_pull_request_reviews":{"require_code_owner_reviews":true,"required_approving_review_count":1},"restrictions":null}' | gh api --method PUT -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' "repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/$(gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef --jq .defaultBranchRef.name)/protection" --input -
